about.title: How I Became a Mobile Developer
about.name: It started with a question: how does this actually work?
about.intro: It started with a question: how does this actually work?
description: My journey into development began at the Tuwaiq Academy bootcamp, where I built my first complete application and truly understood the fundamentals of programming. That experience sparked a deep curiosity about how digital products are built.
After graduating, I started working on small projects that strengthened my skills and gave me real experience solving practical problems through code.
My first professional role introduced me to Flutter, where I spent a year and a half building cross-platform mobile applications and exploring a new side of mobile development.

Later, I returned to my foundation: Kotlin. Since then, I’ve been continuously refining my expertise in Android development, improving my architecture skills, and building applications that are reliable, scalable, and designed to last.

services.mobile: Mobile Development — Native Android with Kotlin. Cross-platform with Flutter. Built to perform.
services.learning: 4+ Years Experience — From bootcamp to production. From solo projects to team collaboration.
services.problemSolving: Problem Solving — I find the friction. Then I remove it.

challenge.title: The Problems I Love to Solve
challenge.intro: I'm drawn to the kind of work that keeps you up at 2am — in a good way.
items: Systems where a 500ms delay costs someone a ride, a sale, or a decision. Zero tolerance for lag.
Code that survives the next developer and the next thousand users. Scalability built in, not bolted on.
When the problem is hard but the solution feels natural — that's where I want to work.
Apps that stay fast when the real world hits them. No shortcuts, no excuses.

skills.title: Tools I Trust
skills.intro: Every tool below has been stress-tested in real projects, debugged at 2am, and refined through iteration. These aren't skills I list — they're tools I trust.
skills.impact: The result: apps that scale, interfaces users don't have to think about, and code your future self will thank you for.

kotlin.label: Kotlin
kotlin.value: Coroutines, Flow, Jetpack Compose, MVVM, Room, Retrofit — native Android from architecture to animation.

flutter.label: Flutter
flutter.value: Cross-platform UI at speed. Bloc/Provider state management. Custom animations and native feel on both platforms.

arch.label: Architecture
arch.value: Clean Architecture — Domain, Data, and Presentation layers. Testable, maintainable, built to survive the next developer.

maps.label: Maps SDK
maps.value: Live tracking, geofencing, route calculation, custom overlays — real-time location at production scale.

vision.title: What I'm Building Toward
vision.text: I'm not just looking for the next project. I'm looking to work on things that matter — apps that solve real friction, platforms that scale beyond the first thousand users, products I'd be proud to say I built. I'm deepening my expertise in real-time systems, exploring the intersection of mobile and AI, and looking to collaborate with teams who build with intention.
